title: Storyblok Story Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for a Storyblok story object as returned by the Content Delivery API

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique numeric identifier of the story

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: Universally unique identifier

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the story in the editor

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-safe slug segment within parent folder

fields.name: full_slug
fields.description: Full path including parent folder slugs

fields.name: default_full_slug
fields.description: Default full slug if language-specific slugs are configured

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 creation timestamp

fields.name: published_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last publication

fields.name: first_published_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of first publication

fields.name: sort_by_date
fields.description: Custom date field for sorting

fields.name: release_id
fields.description: Release ID if story is in a release

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Language code (default or locale code)

fields.name: content
fields.description: Structured content of the story defined by its component schema

fields.name: _uid
fields.description: Unique block identifier

fields.name: component
fields.description: Component type name defining the schema

fields.additionalFields: Dynamic fields defined by the component schema

fields.name: position
fields.description: Sort position within parent folder (lower = higher in list)

fields.name: tag_list
fields.description: Tags assigned to the story

fields.name: is_startpage
fields.description: Whether this story is the folder/space startpage

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: ID of parent folder (0 for root-level stories)

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Shared group ID across language variants of the same story

fields.name: alternates
fields.description: Language alternate versions of this story

fields.name: translated_slugs
fields.description: Language-specific slug overrides
